allocationProbe.boundary: Diagnostic-only libc boundary calls, includes third-party allocations. Nested calls not counted twice. Requested bytes are traffic, not live heap size. Timing includes clock/instrumentation overhead, excludes UE proxy lock acquired before libc. Collected after CPU profilers stop; not used for normal FPS.

environment.boundary: User applications retained, including TGitCache and voice software. No claim of exclusive CPU/GPU ownership. Formal runs exclude builds, packaging and profilers.

boundary: Synthetic allocation speedup is not the game speedup. CPU profile residence includes waits and misses inlined names. Per-thread percentages are not additive frame costs. Instrumented libc timings include clock overhead and exclude outer UE proxy acquisition. Short scene checks cannot prove long-term allocator stability.
